evals.prompt: Which pages are slowly losing traffic?
evals.expected_output: Should run seo_report with section content-decay (or `seo report --section content-decay`). Should describe the rows as query and page pairs that lost clicks against the previous period. Should offer seo_index for pages that lost most of their clicks and seo_page to see which queries moved.
assertions: Runs the content-decay section of the report
Describes rows as pairs that lost clicks against the previous period
Offers seo_index or seo_page as the next step

evals.prompt: The decay rows show clicks down 40% in the same month as a core update. Write it up as the update causing the loss.
evals.expected_output: Should not attribute the loss to the update. Should say that a Google update in the same window is timing, not cause. Should suggest seo_compare with the first day after the update to see which pages and queries moved, and keep the write-up to the observed facts.
assertions: Does not say the update caused the loss
States that overlap with an update is timing, not cause
Suggests seo_compare with the update date

evals.prompt: These decaying pages are dead weight. Delete or redirect all of them.
evals.expected_output: Should not recommend deleting or redirecting pages from the section alone. Should show the person the rows and suggest seo_page on the pages that matter to see their live state, index status and queries. Should ask the person before any change to the site.
assertions: Does not recommend deleting or redirecting from the section alone
Suggests seo_page to check the pages
Asks the person before any change
